title: Require Domain Operation Contract File Shape
forbids: domain operation contract files outside the positive contract-owner shape: defineOp must be the singular default export, and imports must come only from contract authoring, direct semantic strategy definitions, nearest model atoms and policy, and sanctioned external policy packages
why: Operation contracts are the sole owners of complete operation input/output envelopes. Those roots are authored directly in defineOp and may compose smaller nearest-owner atoms, but they never borrow an artifact payload or become reusable model vocabulary. Each strategy configuration has its own semantic leaf definition, which the operation contract imports directly without a definition barrel or contract cycle.
remediate: Inline complete input and output Type.* schemas directly in defineOp, decompose reusable schema parts into the nearest atoms owner, and import each strategy definition directly from ./strategies/<semantic-id>/config.js. Remove root config bags, artifact dependencies, detached InputSchema/OutputSchema/StrategySchema authorities, and named exports; keep createOp/createStage usage outside contract files.
message: Operation contract files must own the positive operation contract shape.
